title: Data-Free Continual Learning for World Action Model with Rectified Generative Replay
title_zh: 基于修正生成重放的“世界动作模型”的数据自由持续学习

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种基于修正生成重放的“世界动作模型”来实现数据自由的持续学习的方法。 World action models (WAMs) built on pretrained video generation models adapt quickly to new robotic tasks, but they forget previously learned tasks under sequential fine-tuning. Experience replay (ER) mitigates such forgetting by rehearsing data of previous tasks, yet this data is often unavailable in robotics, where a policy is deployed as weights only and its training data is not shared along with it. In this work, we ask whether a WAM can achieve data-free continual learning by regenerating its own past. Our key observation is that a WAM can indeed autoregressively regenerate complete rollouts of previously learned tasks and replay them to mitigate forgetting. However, replaying such raw rollouts still lags far behind replaying real data, which we attribute to two issues. First, the WAM is unable to recognize task completion and keeps generating purposeless motion after the task is done. Second, under open-loop generation, the generated actions gradually drift away from the generated observations. To address both issues, we present rectified generative replay (R$^2$-WAM), which truncates generated rollouts at task completion with an agentic evaluator and filters out rollouts whose actions are physically inconsistent with the observations. On the four LIBERO suites and five real-world tasks, R$^2$-WAM reduces forgetting by over 90% relative to sequential fine-tuning and nearly matches ER without accessing any data from previous tasks. Our analysis further reveals that forgetting in WAMs concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling: a forgotten WAM still produces visually plausible observations of previous tasks while its generated actions fail. Project page: https://kaipengfang.github.io/r2-wam/
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种基于修正生成重放的“世界动作模型”（WAM）来实现数据自由持续学习的方法。基于预训练视频生成模型构建的世界动作模型能够迅速适应新的机器人任务，但在连续微调过程中会遗忘之前学习的任务。 经验重放（ER）通过重复演练先前任务的数据来缓解这种遗忘现象，但在机器人领域这些数据通常不可用，因为策略仅以权重形式部署，其训练数据并不会随之一同共享。 在本研究中，我们探讨了一个问题：世界动作模型能否通过重新生成自身的过去经历来实现数据自由的持续学习？ 我们的关键发现是，世界动作模型确实能够自回归地重新生成先前所学任务的完整执行过程，并通过重放这些过程来缓解遗忘。 然而，直接重放此类原始执行过程的效果仍远逊于使用真实数据进行重放，我们认为这源于两个问题。 首先，世界动作模型无法识别任务是否完成，在任务结束后仍会持续生成无目的的动作。 其次，在开环生成过程中，生成的动作会逐渐偏离生成的观察结果。 为了解决这两个问题，我们提出了修正生成重放（R$^2$-WAM）方法：该方法通过智能体评估器在任务完成时截断生成的执行过程，并过滤掉动作与观察结果在物理上不一致的执行过程。 在四个 LIBERO 套件和五个真实世界任务中，R$^2$-WAM 相较于连续微调将遗忘程度降低了超过 90%，且无需访问任何先前任务的数据，其表现几乎与经验重放相当。 我们的分析进一步揭示，世界动作模型的遗忘问题主要集中在逆动力学建模上：被遗忘的世界动作模型仍能生成视觉上合理的先前任务观察结果，但其生成的动作却会失效。 项目页面：https://kaipengfang.github.io/r2-wam/
